messages:
Maria H.: trying to finalize defaults for experiment creation in Console — need input on canary duration, default traffic TTL, and guard behaviors.

Chad L.: my 2c: default canary = 15m, default traffic TTL = 24h (auto-expire unless 'persist'), initial rollout weights: 5%/95% for 2-variant experiments. keep it conservative for latency-sensitive endpoints.

Anya P.: 15m is OK for backend api routes but for streaming/chat I'd prefer 5m canary + lower weight (1-2%) — users notice regressed latency quickly.

Samir R.: routing detail — remember runtime evaluates routing by priority: explicit route > experiment route > default. If experiment's variant is unavailable, fallback should route to baseline model id (configurable). Also we should bubble an event for exposures that hit fallback.

Maria H.: @Chad L. do we have an opinion on whether console defaults should mirror the API SDK behavior? Want parity so infra code paths don't surprise teams.

Chad L.: yes, console should call the same experiments.create API. Console defaults = API defaults. We'll keep them mirrored in the SDK. Add an env flag to override for org-level presets.

Anya P.: UX ask — add a small inline help tooltip: "Canary duration: how long to observe metrics before auto-ramp". And a checkbox: "Auto-pause on error rate X%" with smart default 10%.

Samir R.: implementation note: auto-pause requires a background job that evaluates metric hooks — existing metric-ingestion supports this. Need a contract: experiment should include metric_ids + threshold operators + window_ms.

Maria H.: example simplified experiment payload we'd expect from Console:
```json
{
  "name":"console: onboarding flow test",
  "variants": [{"id":"baseline","weight":9500},{"id":"v1","weight":500}],
  "canary_ms":900000,
  "ttl_ms":86400000,
  "metric_hooks":[{"id":"latency_p95","op":">","threshold":200,"window_ms":300000}],
  "fallback_variant":"baseline"
}
```

Chad L.: can we add a validation rule: if any variant has flagged_status=="experimental" then max allowed weight <= 10% unless org flag set? prevents accidental 100% rollouts.

Anya P.: +1

Samir R.: I'll add runtime guard checks and a unit test to ensure fallback is emitted as an exposure event. Also will add a telemetry tag for "console_created" vs "api_created".

console-bot: note: new UX copy approved in #product.emoji :white_check_mark:

Maria H.: next steps: Chad add API validation PR, Samir add runtime guard + telemetry, Anya will mock the tooltip and checkbox copy. Target EOD next Thursday for alpha.

ops-bot: added action items to the rollout board: https://redwood.example/boards/rollouts/42 :spiral_note_pad:

Chad L.: thanks all :thumbsup:
